summary.oneLiner: PNGS Gargi accelerated store additions to 32 in FY26 (18 in Q4) driving 48% revenue growth, while strategically reducing reliance on parent-company SIS channels from ~78% to a targeted 65% by FY28. The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet with INR 78cr cash, funding aggressive EBO expansion without equity dilution while sustaining ~20% PAT margins despite new store ramp-up periods.

one-line thesis: PNGS Gargi accelerated store additions to 32 in FY26 (18 in Q4) driving 48% revenue growth, while strategically reducing reliance on parent-company SIS channels from ~78% to a targeted 65% by FY28. The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet with INR 78cr cash, funding aggressive EBO expansion without equity dilution while sustaining ~20% PAT margins despite new store ramp-up periods.
financial scorecard: Revenue: INR 149.4cr FY26 (+48% YoY adjusted, +20% unadjusted); Q4 Rev +30.4% YoY. EBITDA/Operating Margin: 42.9% FY26 (Q4: 46%). PAT: INR 5.14cr Q4 (+25.9% YoY), ~20% net margin FY26. Order Book: N/A (Retail). Net Debt: Zero; Cash ~INR 78cr. One-offs: FY25 base included INR 25.74cr exceptional sales from FOCO-to-SIS conversion which was excluded for adjusted growth calc.
guidance: Revenue CAGR ~35% over next few years; Store additions: min 20 in FY27 (potential for more); Margins: EBITDA/PAT expected to remain stable (~20% PAT) with potential 100-150bps upside if new stores mature faster.
order book & pipeline: N/A - Retail business model; Focus on same-store sales growth (SSSG ~30-32% in mature SIS) and new store contribution.
segment / subsidiary detail: SIS (P.N. Gadgil): ~78% of revenue FY26, targeting reduction to 65% by FY28. EBO/Other: ~22% of revenue FY26, becoming primary growth engine. Product Mix: 14KT Diamond ~35% of revenue; Sterling Silver balance.
growth verticals / optionality: Untapped Maharashtra Tier 2/3 cities (Pune alone supports 8-10 more stores); Pan-India expansion into North (priority) and South (Hyderabad/Chennai/Bangalore initiated); Kiosk format in malls for lower capex entry.
margins & cost dynamics: Raw material volatility (Silver/Gold) managed via MRP pricing adjustments (cushion of INR 30-40k/kg for silver); Marketing spend low at 4-5% of sales; Local manufacturing (karigars) offsetting rising HR/rent costs.
capex / expansion: FOCO/EBO unit economics: INR 80L-1Cr per store (INR 30-50L fit-out + INR 25L+ inventory deposit); Franchisee funded for FOCO; Company funded for COCO; Total capacity to fund 25+ stores via internal accruals.
capital allocation: Debt-free expansion prioritized; No equity dilution planned for organic growth; Cash reserves (INR 78cr) deployed for new EBOs; Open to inorganic acquisitions if strategically fit.
risks & watch-items: New store maturation delay (15-18 months outside Maharashtra vs 6-9 months in Maharashtra); Concentration risk with P.N. Gadgil SIS though reducing; Real estate availability in premium mall locations.
management quality / tone: Confident yet conservative; Emphasis on 'not less than' guidance to under-promise/over-deliver; Pragmatic on geography (profit over rigid state targets); Cautious on ATL marketing spend.
non-obvious takeaways: Inventory strategy shift: Ban on imported ready silver jewelry forced vertical integration with local karigars using Italian/Turkish machinery, improving making cost margins; SSG in parent SIS channels running at 30-32% despite large base.

Gadgil provides immediate cash flow while EBOs mature. |

themes.title: Jewellery & wedding-economy formalization
themes.need: Organized jewellery is gaining share via capital-light FOCO expansion and GST/hallmarking formalization, even amid record gold-price volatility. KALYANKJIL posted Q4 revenue +66% YoY with 150 new FY27 stores and a near-zero non-GML-debt target; SENCO/PNGJL/DPABHUSHAN ride regional formalization; SKYGOLD/RGL/GOLDIAM on B2B and lab-grown export; KALAMANDIR on the wedding-wear economy.
themes.driver: Akshaya Tritiya / wedding-season demand; FOCO store rollout; gold-price stabilization lifting volumes.
